title: Pick a Vault From the Launcher

steps.intent: open the launcher and press Pick Vault on a Bare row to see the Rune Vault list
choose Custom and tick one set, then read which sets are ticked
change my mind: untick it, tick a different set, then choose another vault in the list, without pressing Launch
check the list shows vault and set names only, with no raw ids and no duplicates, and closing Pick Vault starts no session
